page.layout: One printed page with a running head and page number at the top of the text column; main text in one column; a narrow partly visible column of marginal notes at the right edge (cropped, mostly illegible from this scan). Below the scan's text block, a digitiser's banner, which is left out.

main_text.p: chum, ablegeturque in Monasterium Kiriliense, quod centum miliaribus distat à Moscua, situm ad ripam Sochinæ: & sententia hæc executionem sortitur duodecimâ Junii, eodem anno 1648.
main_text.head: Quæstio XXVI.

p.i: Opposita pars præcedentis quæstionis hîc tenetur.

main_text.p: Mitior est naturalis quàm artificiofus ignis: Nam si intempestâ forte noê‑te, non ritè sopitus focus, alicubi fecerit incendium, exciti ad pulsum Feralis Nolæ, concurrimus protinus cum scalis & hamis: & hinc detractis, qui suppetebant in pabulum, titionibus, depluentibus illinc syphonibus & situlis, tandem abigimus indi‑gnan‑

page.notes: The first word of the body text is a large woodcut initial "M", joined to "Itior" as "Mitior". The marginal notes at the right edge are cropped and unreadable, so they are not transcribed. Line-end hyphens are printed and kept. The catchword and signature are not visible.
